basics.name: Eskil Gaasø Indrestrand
basics.label: PhD Research Fellow
basics.summary: PhD Research Fellow at the Department of Sociology and Political Science, NTNU.

work.name: NTNU, Department of Sociology and Political Science
work.summary: Research focus: how AI affects decision-making and productivity in the Norwegian central government.
highlights: Lecturer in the Specialization in Public Administration and the Master's Programme in Teacher Education.
Member of the research groups Public Policy and Administration, and Technology and Social Change.
Elected and appointed roles: Department Board (2025-2026); Faculty PhD Programme Committee (2026-2027); Faculty Board, Research Committee, and Hiring Committee (2026-2027); NTNU Board (2026-2027).
Reviewer for Public Management Review and International Journal of Public Administration.
Local organizing committee, International Research Society for Public Management (IRSPM) conference 2027.
Affiliated with the research schools NORA (Norwegian Artificial Intelligence Research Consortium) and Digit (The Norwegian Research School on Digitalization, Culture and Society).

work.name: NTNU, Department of Sociology and Political Science
work.summary: Responsible for teaching statistics to 40 Master's and PhD students in the course SOS3003.
highlights: Led 18 seminars in applied statistics (linear and logistic regression) using STATA.
Increased student attendance and received strong anonymous evaluations.
Coordinated teaching with two professors and other course staff, revising the course for the following year.

education.institution: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)
highlights: Specialization in quantitative methods, political violence, and public administration.
